messages:
Jordan H: heads up — planning a coordinated maintenance this Thurs 02:00-05:00 UTC for a few infra changes across us-east1 + eu-central. scope: BMC firmware update on 2 racks, secondary SSD firmware on compute nodes, and an egress shaping change (MTU & policing) that needs node drains. aiming for rolling drains with <3min disruption per node.
Maria P: rough impact on GPU capacity? any expected slot loss/blocking for reserved customers?
Alex K: estimate: 6 racks affected, ~120 GPU nodes. we can keep Dedicated pools pinned and shift spots; expect ~8-12% usable pool reduction per region during drain windows. will open extra warm nodes in eu-central 45m before start to backfill.
SRE_Lead: canaries first — pick 3 nodes in us-east1 with test jobs only. if BMC cycle or SSD update causes degraded kernel or stale nvme mapping, abort and escalate. rollback plan: stop firmware job, power-cycle BMC, restore previous SSD FW via vendor tool.
Jordan H: schedule proposal: stagger by rack, 20m per rack (10m drain/warmup, 5m firmware, 5m verify). total window 3h covers both regions with overlap buffer.
Maya O: operational notes — runbook needs small edits: add `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60` snippet and a step to flush prefix cache after node comes back. also update status page and incident channel before each rack starts.
Alex K: snippet for drain command I'm planning to run: ```kubectl drain node/gpu-012 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60 --timeout=600s``` follow with health-check: `curl -f http://scheduler.internal/health || alert`
ops-bot: scheduled_maint_bot: maintenance window created: 2026-03-26 02:00-05:00 UTC. Notifying oncall and status page.
Finance M: quick cost note — warming dedicated nodes adds ~$X/hr per region; if we overprovision more than 2 hours it's cheaper to accept short spot preempts. I'll run a delta calc once Alex posts exact warm node counts.
Maria P: also watch egress shaping — some customers stream large embeddings; recommend a canary traffic policy (5% route to shaped egress) for first 30m post-change.
SRE_Lead: agreed. rollout policy: canary -> 20% -> full over 90m. if error rate >1% or L95 latency increases >150ms rollback.
Jordan H: final checklist: runbooks updated (Maya), canary nodes reserved (Alex), finance OK with warm node window (Finance M), status page message draft (Maya). I'll kick off runbook readout Mon EOD. Any objections? :eyes:
Maria P: none from me, go ahead. :thumbsup:
Alex K: will post warm node counts by EOD and update the maintenance ticket with exact rack order.
SRE_Lead: I'll be oncall for the window and will have escalation tree in the thread.
ops-bot: reminder set — 30m pre-window and 5m pre-drain pings to #eng-oncall.
